title: Outside client: questions, UAT and client approval
docs: Open questions (client and internal) with their answers

replacements.CLIENT_ROLE: - The **client** clarifies requirements, answers questions (`docs/questions.md`), runs acceptance testing (UAT) and gives final approval.
replacements.CLIENT_ROLE_ROW: | Client | Clarifies requirements, answers questions, runs UAT, approves each requirement |
replacements.CLIENT_STATUS_ROWS:
| `clarify` | Waits on a client answer; the question is in `q: Q-xx` (required) | Client, then Claude records the answer |
| `uat` | Handed to the client for acceptance testing | Client |
replacements.CLIENT_DONE_RULE: ; a requirement card becomes `done` only after the client accepts it in UAT, and the supervisor records that approval (`[approved]` log line)
